dataset.title: Pharmaceutical net imports, % of imports (HS 30), 2024

indicator.name: Pharmaceutical net import share
indicator.description: 100 × (imports − exports) ÷ imports, HS 30, 2024. 100 = imports everything it uses and exports nothing; ≤ 0 = net exporter.

source.name: Derived from ITC Trade Map (via Wikipedia) pharmaceutical imports and exports
source.license: Wikipedia text CC BY-SA 4.0; ITC Trade Map data, attribution required

notes: A proxy for medicine import reliance: domestic production is not in the data, so a country that makes and consumes its own medicines but also imports a lot can look dependent.
caveats: Re-export hubs (Belgium, Netherlands, Ireland, Switzerland) show large trade both ways; their share says little about survival dependence.

scoring.rationale: Already a 0–100 share for net importers; net exporters (≤ 0) score 0.
